hint.name: ariadne-core
hint.limits: What this project deliberately does not do

project.joinInstead: Joining somebody else's team? I have an invitation code

error.name: A project needs a name.
error.repoTaken: You already have a project for this repository.

project.previewEmpty: The card grows as you fill it in. The agent reads it on every question about this project.
project.repoLead: The repository address is the field that matters most here. Your coder finds this project by that, not by its name: started inside the repository it reads the address and asks Ariadne about that one. Enter what `git remote get-url origin` prints.

repoNote.set: The repository you run your coder in has to carry this same address. github.com/you/project, https://... and git@... all count as the same one.
repoNote.fallback: Left empty, so the project will be filed as {ref}. A coder finds it only if you hand it that exact string, because it cannot read it from any directory.

project.workspaceNote: The archive decides who reads this project: you alone, or the whole team. Your coder reaches all of your archives, so this does not affect it.

etapChoice.prototyp: Prototype - still being built, nobody uses it yet
etapChoice.produkcja: Released - people are using it and it works
etapChoice.utrzymanie: Maintenance - no new features, fixes only

limits.note: Already have this in CONVENTIONS.md or .cursorrules? Load it instead of retyping.
limits.tooBig: That file is larger than {kb} KB. Paste just the rules from it.
limits.unreadable: That file could not be read. Pick a text file.

agent.title: Connect your agent
agent.label: YOUR AGENT
agent.what: This command adds Ariadne to your agent as a memory source. The token is embedded in it and never touches your repository.
agent.where: Paste it in a terminal and press Enter. Not using a terminal? Skip this step, the app works without an agent.
agent.tokenOnce: You see this token now and never again. A lost token is replaced with a new one in settings.
agent.tokenFailed: The token was not generated, so the command is not ready. Try again.

other.note: There is no ready-made command for this agent. Point it at the MCP server at {url} with an Authorization: Bearer header carrying the token below.

agent.copyUnavailable: Copying is unavailable. Select the command and copy it by hand.
agent.tokenWhat: This is your token. Give it to the agent as an Authorization: Bearer header.
agent.tokenWhere: Copy it now. Once you leave this screen you will not see it again.
agent.whereToRun: Run this command inside this project's repository, not in some other directory. A coder reports the address of the repository it is standing in, and this project is filed under:
agent.mustMatch: If the two do not match, the coder is told the repository is unknown. You can change the project's address at any time on its card.
agent.onceOnly: You run this command once per machine, not once per project. It covers all of your projects at once. A second attempt answers "already exists in user config", which means everything is connected already.
agent.joinedArchive: The token just created reaches all of your archives, including the one you joined. What your coder writes in the team's projects, the whole team sees.
agent.joinedWhereToRun: Run your coder in the repository of whichever project you mean to write about. Each team project shows its address on its own card in the app.

key.title: Your Gemini key

lead.none: Ariadne uses Gemini for two things: turning entries into vectors so they can be searched, and writing the answers to your questions. Every request is billed to your own Google account, which is why a key is required to go on.
lead.user: This account already has a key. Type a new one to replace it.

key.required: A key is required. Requests to Gemini are paid for by the account that makes them, so without one you cannot write or search an entry.
key.keptIfEmpty: Leave it empty to keep the key you already have.
key.requiredError: Paste a Gemini key to go on.

join.title: Join a team
join.lead: Paste the invitation code you were given. You land in somebody else's archive together with its projects, so you do not need one of your own.
join.note: The code is tied to your address. One written for somebody else will not work.
join.back: I would rather start my own project

error.bad: That code does not work. Check that it is complete and was written for your address.

join.leadWaiting: An invitation written to your address is already here. You land in somebody else's archive with its projects, so you need none of your own.
join.orPaste: Or paste a code somebody handed you

common.failed: That did not work. Try again.
common.noGeminiKey: There is no Gemini key, so Ariadne can neither answer nor record an entry. Add one in settings.

unknownRepo.what: A coder asked for the repository {repo}, which none of your archives holds.
unknownRepo.means: A coder finds a project by the address of the repository it is standing in, so it was told no such project exists. Create it and say which archive it lives in.

home.stale: Data from {at}. The server is not responding, so it may be out of date.

empty.title: No project yet
empty.note: A project is where Ariadne keeps decisions and agreements. Create your first one to start.

home.askTitle: What do you want to know?
home.memoryLine: Ariadne answers from {entries, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} recorded in this project.
home.decisionsEmptyNote: The first ones arrive on their own once an agent finishes a session. You can also write one yourself under Add to memory.
home.waitingEmptyNote: When an agent or a conversation proposes a change, it shows up here.

assistant.suggest2: Why did we choose this stack?

database.placeholder: E.g. We switched the form library from X to Y, because...

database.hint: Enter sends, Shift + Enter starts a new line
database.nothingProposedNote: Ariadne found nothing in this that needs recording or correcting.
database.historyEmpty: You have not added any context yet.
database.historyEmptyNote: Describe your first decision or change, and the whole run of it stays here.

pending.toastConfirmed: Entry added to the project context.
pending.toastFailed: That did not work. Try again.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.lead: Manage the work of people and agents.
tasks.emptyNote: When a human or an agent leaves concrete work for later, it appears here.
tasks.unreachableNote: Tasks could not be loaded. Check that the Ariadne server is running and try again.
tasks.noProjectNote: Create a project first, then tasks will belong to that project.

project.repoWarning: This is the address a coder finds this project by. Changing it means a coder working in the old repository stops seeing it.

delete.title: Deleting the project
delete.warning: This project goes, and the whole archive with it: {count} entries, their anchors, the review queue and the chats. It cannot be undone or recovered.
delete.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can delete a project.
delete.failed: The project could not be deleted. Try again.

duplicate.title: This repository sits in two archives
duplicate.body: The address {repo} also belongs to: {where}. A coder finds a project by that address, so with two matches it refuses to guess and opens neither.
duplicate.fix: Keep the address on one project and change it on the other, move the project into the right archive, or delete it.

move.label: ARCHIVE
move.note: The entries and the review queue travel with the project. The archive decides who reads it: everyone in the one it leaves loses access.
move.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can move a project.
move.failed: The project could not be moved. Try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Account, what agents may do, tokens and team.
settings.accountErrorNote: Account settings could not be loaded. Check that the Ariadne server is running and try again.
settings.profileNote: The agent is given this text at the start of every session.

geminiState.user: Ariadne embeds and answers on your key. Requests from this account are billed to you at Google.
geminiState.none: There is no key, so writing entries, searching and both chats do not work. Add one to turn them on.

settings.geminiNote: The key is encrypted before it is stored and never comes back from the server.
settings.autoApproveIsOff: Everything the agent writes waits for you in the queue: new entries, edits and deletions alike. Until you approve it the agent cannot see it, so it will not build its next answer on it.
settings.autoApproveIsOn: The agent writes, edits and archives immediately, without asking. Its entries count as project memory from the first second and come back in search. The review queue stays empty.
settings.tokensLead: One token per machine you work on. It reaches all of your archives, and the repository address picks the project. You see a token once, when it is created.
settings.tokenOnce: Copy it now, it is not shown again
settings.tokenOnceWhere: Paste it into your agent's configuration, where it asks for the Ariadne token.
settings.tokensEmptyNote: Create one to connect Claude Code or another agent to this memory.
settings.tokensMoved: Agent connection setup (Claude Code, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Codex) and access tokens have moved to a dedicated section.
settings.passwordViaProvider: This account signs in through Google or GitHub, so it has no password to change.
settings.skillsLead: Agent skills live in directories on this computer. Each tool reads its own, so a skill one of them sees can be invisible to another.
settings.skillsRestartNote: The links appear at once. A running Claude or Codex session will not see the new skills until it is started again.
settings.skillsBroken: {count, plural, one {One link leads nowhere.} other {# links lead nowhere.}}
settings.skillsLinked: {count, plural, =0 {No new link was made.} one {Made # link.} other {Made # links.}}
settings.skillsConflicts: {count, plural, one {Left # name alone: another directory holds it.} other {Left # names alone: another directory holds them.}}
settings.skillsFailedCount: {count, plural, one {# link could not be made.} other {# links could not be made.}}
settings.skillsError: Could not read the skill directories
settings.skillsErrorNote: Check that .agents, .claude and .codex are in your home directory.
settings.skillsBrowserOnly: Skills live on disk, so only the application window can read them. In a browser this section shows nothing.

conflict.title: CONTRADICTION
conflict.lead: This entry clashes with something already in memory. Both cannot be true at once, so say which one stands. The other does not disappear: it is marked as overruled and keeps a link to what replaced it.

done.new: The older entry is marked as overruled.
done.old: The new entry is marked as overruled.

teams.title: Teams
teams.lead: A team is a shared archive. Whoever belongs to it sees every project inside and everything you have recorded in them.

join.title: Join a team
join.note: Answer an invitation written to you, or paste a code somebody handed over.

mine.title: My teams
mine.note: The archives you belong to: who is in them and which projects they hold.

code.title: You were given a code
code.lead: A code passed to you by hand works here too.
code.leadAlone: Nothing is waiting for your answer right now. If somebody passed you an invitation code, paste it here.
code.label: Invitation code
code.note: The code is tied to your address. One written for somebody else will not work.
code.errorBad: That code does not work. Check that it is complete and was written for your address.

teams.noTeams: You are not working with anyone yet
teams.noTeamsNote: Invite somebody to your own archive below and it becomes a team. They will see every project in it and be able to write to them.
teams.privateNote: Only you can see this archive. Invite somebody and it becomes a team, together with every project already in it.
teams.inviteEmailNote: The code will only work for this address. Leave it empty and it opens for whoever receives it.
teams.inviteOpen: Open code, for whoever receives it
teams.inviteWhere: Pass it to them. They paste it under Teams, or in the wizard when they create their account.
teams.newTeamNote: A separate archive for projects you run with somebody else.

hints.claude-code: Registration covers the whole machine, so the directory does not matter here. The project directory matters once you start working: Ariadne recognises the project by its repository address.
hints.antigravity: Make sure the project is open in the Antigravity workspace.
hints.gemini-cli: settings.json is shared by all of your projects.
hints.codex: Registration covers the whole machine, so the directory does not matter here. The project directory matters once you start working: Ariadne recognises the project by its repository address.
hints.other: Your client has to support MCP servers over HTTP.

agentsPage.title: Connect agent
agentsPage.lead: Connect your coding tool to this project's memory.
agentsPage.tokensLead: One token covers a whole machine and every archive you can reach. You see its full value once, when it is created.
agentsPage.tokenOnce: Copy this token now — it will not be shown again
agentsPage.tokenOnceWhere: We automatically filled it into the guide below. Save it if you wish to reuse it in other tools.
agentsPage.tokensEmptyNote: Without a token an agent has nothing to identify itself with. Create the first one above.
agentsPage.revokeAskNote: An agent using it loses access to the archive on its next connection. This cannot be undone.
agentsPage.unknownRepo: It asked for the repository {repo}, which is in none of your archives.
